question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of fiber optic networks in Spain, with operator and status?

answer.summary: No national open dataset of fibre routes was found. Best official source: Catalonia CTTI cables (2,216 lines, exact geometry, owner CTTI, no status). ITU BBMaps WFS gives national but schematic 2-point links with status and no operator. Operators (Reintel, Digi, lyntia) publish pictures only; the state PIU is restricted to accredited operators.
main_caveats: Gencat coordinates are UTM metres (EPSG:25831 inferred) in a file called GeoJSON; reproject before use. All 2,216 rows have owner and manager CTTI.
ITU links are 2-vertex straight lines between nodes and the Spain bbox also returns Portugal, France and North Africa; they are not cable routes.
RD 330/2016 art. 5 obliges infrastructure owners to give location and layout on written request; the PIU (Orden ECE/529/2019) lists contacts and works only. The 2026 draft order is not approved.
OSM telecom lines in three regions sampled (La Rioja, Navarra, Cantabria) have no telecom:medium=fibre and almost no operator tags.
CNMC and SETID coverage data are municipal or province aggregates of homes passed, not routes.
answer.confidence_reason: Searched all eight site types and opened regulator pages; OSM tested on 3 regions only and Overpass was unreachable, so inland OSM coverage in Spain is not counted.

attributes.note: Exact only for Catalonia (CTTI), one town, one island, Andalusian subsea; national ITU links are straight 2-point segments.
attributes.gap_note: No national or private-operator route file found in CNMC, SETID, datos.gob.es, ITU, OSM, operator pages; PIU is restricted.

attributes.note: Gencat: owner/manager CTTI (all rows); towns by context. ITU and EMODnet carry no operator field.
attributes.gap_note: Opened ITU, EMODnet, OSM samples, operator maps: no per-route operator for private networks.

attributes.note: ITU: operational/planned/under construction on schematic links; EMODnet: operativos/abandonados (Andalusia only).
attributes.gap_note: Gencat and municipal files have no status field; no dated status found anywhere.
